story: Until 2026-12-29 (32 days), options price KOTAKBANK to move about ±5.0%, roughly 477 to 528. In the past, the price ended inside the range priced this way 62% of the time.
Options are cheap compared with how much KOTAKBANK has actually been moving: they price 21.3% a year while the last month realised 25.2%.
KOTAKBANK has actually been moving about 1.59% a day this past month: on the high side for it against the past year.

For the 2026-12-29 expiry, the biggest pile of call positions is at 520 (+4.0% away) and the biggest pile of put positions is at 500 (+0.0%). Option sellers defend these levels, so price often slows near them, but they shift as positions change.

iv.analyst: 30-day constant-maturity ATM IV 21.3%: 50th percentile of 1 year, 38th of all days since 2019-01-01.

vrp.simple: Options are cheap compared with how much KOTAKBANK has actually been moving: they price 21.3% a year while the last month realised 25.2%.
vrp.analyst: IV30 - RV21 = -3.9 vol points, 15th percentile of the past year. Since 2019-01-01, IV30 was above the volatility that actually followed over the next 21 sessions on 64% of days: option sellers are usually paid a premium for carrying the risk, and the gap is what that premium looks like today.

term.simple: Longer-dated options on KOTAKBANK cost more than near ones: the normal, calm shape.

skew.simple: Calls and puts the same distance from the price cost about the same (gap -0.8 vol points): no strong demand for either protection or upside. Against the past year, that gap is normal for KOTAKBANK.
skew.analyst: 25-delta risk reversal -0.84 vol pts (front month), 63rd percentile of the past year. More negative = more demand for downside insurance relative to upside.

realised.analyst: RV21 25.2% (76th percentile of the past year), RV5 33.8%, RV63 22.3%; RV5/RV63 compression at the 90th percentile.

oi.analyst: Front-expiry PCR (OI) 0.65; all-expiry OI PCR at the 33rd percentile of the past year. Today's change: calls +2,106,000, puts +978,000 (OI units, i.e. shares or index quantity). A high PCR in India mostly reflects put writing, so it is read as crowding, not as a signal.

futures.simple: KOTAKBANK futures trade 2.9 points above the price itself. That premium works out to 6.6% a year, within its usual range for the past year.
futures.analyst: Near-month basis +2.9, annualised carry 6.6% (55th percentile of the past year; its 1-year median 6.2%). Last 5 sessions (price x OI, same contracts day to day): Long build-up, Long unwinding, Long build-up, Long unwinding, Long unwinding. Build-up labels describe what happened to positions; they do not say who is right.

move.analyst: ATM straddle / forward = 5.02% (forward 502.7). Scored on 1,955 days since 2019-01-01 against the official close on each expiry; a straddle is the market's mean absolute move, so about 57% inside is what a fair price would give.
